description: This Java source file defines the KeyboardExtensionFactory class, which extends AddOnsFactory.SingleAddOnsFactory to create and manage KeyboardExtension instances for different keyboard extension types within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles parsing XML attributes to instantiate specific keyboard extensions based on configuration.

classes.name: KeyboardExtensionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing keyboard extension instances based on configuration and XML attributes.

methods.name: KeyboardExtensionFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with context, default add-on ID, preference prefix, and extension type.

methods.name: createConcreteAddOn
methods.description: Creates a KeyboardExtension instance based on XML attributes, parsing resource IDs and extension types, and ensuring they match the factory's extension type.

methods.name: getExtensionType
methods.description: Returns the extension type managed by this factory.
